Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Premature Identification of Historical Figure without Verification

The Planner made an error in Step 1 by immediately asserting that "The president born on the Fourth of July is Calvin Coolidge" and stating his birthplace as "Plymouth Notch, Vermont" before any external verification was performed. While it is historically true that Calvin Coolidge was born on July 4, the task required identifying the president based on the birth date. The Planner failed to use the WebSurfer agent to first confirm which president was born on July 4. Instead, the Planner assumed the identity of the president and then proceeded to verify the birthplace of that assumed identity. This is a classic case of "Misidentification of Historical Figures" due to reliance on internal knowledge rather than the systematic, evidence-gathering process the task required. The error was compounded by the subsequent focus on verifying the specific location (Plymouth Notch vs. Plymouth) rather than first confirming the subject of the query.
